entries.description: Contributing to the development of production-grade AI solutions, focusing on Generative AI enablement and building trusted enterprise knowledge systems. Implementing modern data architectures to scale AI capabilities for global clients.

Developing scalable full-stack applications with Next.js, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB. Built responsive UI components, integrated REST APIs, and implemented secure authentication with role-based access control.
Research-oriented software development in hardware security. Implemented computational models and contributed to system-level problem solving.
Conducted practical sessions in programming and web development. Mentored students on logical thinking, algorithms, and real-world software practices.

Developed full-stack web apps using React, Tailwind, Node.js, and MongoDB. Designed RESTful APIs with JWT auth, built admin dashboards, employee management systems, and worked on HRMS maintenance with Laravel.
